flagMatch.heading: Choose your Flag Matching challenge
flagMatch.summary: Pick the full World mode for ranked streaks or focus on a single continent to memorize regional flags faster on an interactive blank map.
flagMatch.rule1: Select World mode to compete on the daily and all-time global leaderboards.
flagMatch.rule2: Choose any continent (Europe, Asia, Africa, Americas, or Oceania) for focused practice.
flagMatch.rule3: Zoom and pan freely; small island nations include clickable circular markers.
flagMatch.scope: Covers around 200 sovereign states and playable territories with crisp vector flags, localized country names, optional name hints, and instant feedback.

flagMatchWorld.heading: About World Flag Match
flagMatchWorld.summary: Identify every national flag and click the matching country on the interactive world map. Build the longest error-free streak to climb global leaderboards.
flagMatchWorld.rule1: Look at the flag displayed in the top HUD and click its country on the map.
flagMatchWorld.rule2: Toggle the country name hint if you are learning, or skip tough flags to keep moving.
flagMatchWorld.rule3: Your best streak in World mode counts toward both daily and all-time rankings when signed in.
flagMatchWorld.scope: Includes sovereign nations across all continents plus special territories, with dedicated markers for microstates and Pacific or Caribbean islands.

flagMatchEurope.heading: About Europe Flag Match
flagMatchEurope.summary: Focus exclusively on European nations, from Nordic and Baltic flags to Central Europe, the Balkans, and Mediterranean microstates.
flagMatchEurope.rule1: Every target flag belongs to Europe; non-European countries are locked out.
flagMatchEurope.rule2: Use zoom to click smaller states like Malta, Andorra, Liechtenstein, San Marino, and Vatican City.
flagMatchEurope.rule3: Practice freely at your own pace with instant color feedback and streak tracking.
flagMatchEurope.scope: Great for mastering look-alike tricolors, Nordic crosses, and Eastern European borders before attempting the full World Flag Match challenge.

flagMatchAsia.heading: About Asia Flag Match
flagMatchAsia.summary: Train your recognition of Asian country flags across the Middle East, Central Asia, South Asia, East Asia, and Southeast Asia.
flagMatchAsia.rule1: Match each displayed Asian flag to its territory on the zoomable blank map.
flagMatchAsia.rule2: Zoom in on the Arabian Peninsula, Caucasus, and Southeast Asian archipelagos for precise clicks.
flagMatchAsia.rule3: Reveal the country name whenever you need a hint, then replay to beat your streak.
flagMatchAsia.scope: Covers all Asian sovereign states plus Taiwan and Palestine, helping you separate similar crescent, star, and pan-Arab flag designs.

flagMatchAfrica.heading: About Africa Flag Match
flagMatchAfrica.summary: Master all African country flags from the Maghreb and Sahel to the Horn of Africa, Central Africa, and Southern African nations.
flagMatchAfrica.rule1: Click the African country that matches the flag shown in the top panel.
flagMatchAfrica.rule2: Use zoom and circular island markers for Cape Verde, Comoros, Mauritius, Seychelles, and São Tomé.
flagMatchAfrica.rule3: Track your streak across the whole continent and skip any flag to review it later.
flagMatchAfrica.scope: Designed to help you tell apart pan-African red-yellow-green flags and memorize borders across all five African subregions.

flagMatchAmericas.heading: About Americas Flag Match
flagMatchAmericas.summary: Practice flags of North America, Central America, South America, and the Caribbean islands on a single interactive map.
flagMatchAmericas.rule1: Match each flag to its country across mainland America and Caribbean island chains.
flagMatchAmericas.rule2: Zoom into the Lesser Antilles where island markers make tiny nations easy to click.
flagMatchAmericas.rule3: Build a continuous streak and reveal country names anytime to reinforce memory.
flagMatchAmericas.scope: Ideal for distinguishing Central American blue-and-white flags, Andean tricolors, and island flags across the Caribbean Sea.

flagMatchOceania.heading: About Oceania Flag Match
flagMatchOceania.summary: Test your knowledge of Australia, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea, and Pacific island nations scattered across Melanesia, Micronesia, and Polynesia.
flagMatchOceania.rule1: Match each Oceanian flag to its landmass or highlighted Pacific island marker.
flagMatchOceania.rule2: Pan across the Pacific Ocean and zoom in to separate neighboring island archipelagos.
flagMatchOceania.rule3: Use the name toggle to learn unfamiliar island flags and replay until you score 100%.
flagMatchOceania.scope: Helps you master Union Jack ensigns, Southern Cross stars, and remote Pacific island locations that often end World mode streaks.

physicalGeo.heading: Physical Geography Map Quiz Overview
physicalGeo.summary: Go beyond political borders and test where Earth’s major landforms and bodies of water sit on a borderless physical world map.
physicalGeo.rule1: Choose one of four categories: Mountain Ranges, Rivers, Deserts, or Waters.
physicalGeo.rule2: Read the highlighted feature name in the HUD and click its exact shape on the map.
physicalGeo.rule3: Zoom in closely for smaller rivers, lakes, straits, and regional mountain chains.
physicalGeo.scope: Covers iconic natural features worldwide with localized EN, CS, and DE names, smooth vector overlays, and instant streak feedback.

physicalGeoMountains.heading: About World Mountain Ranges Quiz
physicalGeoMountains.summary: Locate major mountain systems and highland chains on a blank physical map, from the Himalayas and Andes to the Alps, Rockies, and Urals.
physicalGeoMountains.rule1: Find the prompted mountain range on the map and click directly on its highlighted polygon.
physicalGeoMountains.rule2: Zoom in on Europe, Central Asia, or the Americas when ranges sit close together.
physicalGeoMountains.rule3: Skip tricky ranges to see the map automatically pan to their location and learn them.
physicalGeoMountains.scope: Includes major continental divides, alpine systems, and classic school-geography mountain ranges across every inhabited continent.

physicalGeoRivers.heading: About World Rivers Quiz
physicalGeoRivers.summary: Trace Earth’s great river systems across all continents, including the Nile, Amazon, Yangtze, Mississippi, Danube, Rhine, and Mekong.
physicalGeoRivers.rule1: Click along the course of the river requested in the top HUD bar.
physicalGeoRivers.rule2: Zoom into dense river basins in Europe, China, and South America for pinpoint accuracy.
physicalGeoRivers.rule3: Use Skip to pan directly to an unknown river and build your streak on the next run.
physicalGeoRivers.scope: Great for students and trivia players learning major drainage basins, river mouths, and transboundary waterways around the globe.

physicalGeoDeserts.heading: About World Deserts Quiz
physicalGeoDeserts.summary: Pinpoint the largest hot and cold deserts on Earth, including the Sahara, Arabian, Gobi, Kalahari, Atacama, Mojave, and Australian deserts.
physicalGeoDeserts.rule1: Click the shaded desert region that matches the name shown in the HUD.
physicalGeoDeserts.rule2: Pay attention to neighboring deserts in Central Asia, Australia, and North America.
physicalGeoDeserts.rule3: Skip any unfamiliar desert to center the map on its exact geographic region.
physicalGeoDeserts.scope: Covers classic subtropical, rain-shadow, coastal, and continental deserts taught in physical geography courses.

physicalGeoWaters.heading: About Seas, Oceans and Lakes Quiz
physicalGeoWaters.summary: Identify the world’s oceans, marginal seas, gulfs, bays, straits, and major inland lakes on an interactive hydrographic map.
physicalGeoWaters.rule1: Click the ocean, sea, gulf, or lake requested in the top prompt.
physicalGeoWaters.rule2: Zoom into enclosed waterways such as the Mediterranean, Baltic, Red Sea, or Great Lakes.
physicalGeoWaters.rule3: Use Skip to reveal and pan directly to smaller seas and inland basins.
physicalGeoWaters.scope: Combines marine regions and major freshwater or saline lakes (like Baikal, Caspian, Victoria, and Tanganyika) in one comprehensive water quiz.

guessCountry.heading: About Guess the Country Quiz
guessCountry.summary: Deduce a mystery country in up to five guesses using real-time geodesic distance, compass bearing, and continent clues on the world map.
guessCountry.rule1: Click any country on the map to submit your first guess and reveal how close you are.
guessCountry.rule2: Follow the kilometer distance, compass arrow, and color temperature toward the hidden nation.
guessCountry.rule3: Find the target within five attempts to win, then start a new randomized round immediately.
guessCountry.scope: Trains spatial intuition, relative positions, and continental geography across all playable countries without relying on flags or names first.

worldMap.heading: Interactive World Map Explorer
worldMap.summary: Browse every country on a smooth zoomable world map to inspect national flags, official names, and capital cities before taking a quiz.
worldMap.rule1: Hover over any country on desktop or tap on mobile to preview its name.
worldMap.rule2: Click a country to lock its flag, localized name, and capital in the top info panel.
worldMap.rule3: Scroll or pinch to zoom into Europe, the Caribbean, or the Pacific Islands.
worldMap.scope: Built as a fast visual study companion alongside the Country Encyclopedia and Flag Match quizzes, supporting English, Czech, and German names.
